providers.name: International Printing Museum
providers.schedule: Saturday Merit Badge Days, 9 AM - 3 PM, several times a year. Both badges in one day.
providers.notes: Advance registration required (via Eventbrite). Troops paying for 5+ Scouts can contact the museum to avoid the Eventbrite fee.

providers.name: Southern California Railway Museum
providers.cost: $45 + fees per program (discounts for multiple programs by phone)
providers.schedule: Railroading: 4th Saturday of each month, 9 AM - 1 PM (not Jul-Sep, Nov, Dec). Other badges: odd months at 1 PM.
providers.notes: Led by certified merit badge counselors; lunch or snack included. Contact scouting@socalrailway.org.

providers.name: USS Midway Museum
providers.address: 910 N Harbor Dr, San Diego, CA 92101
providers.schedule: Scheduled sessions, 3.5-4 hours. Aviation can be combined with the Overnight Adventure program.
providers.notes: Prerequisites required. Aviation: 10-30 Scouts; Radio: 5-16 Scouts. Email youthprograms@midway.org.

providers.name: Jason & the Dragonauts - STEM merit badges at the Disney parks
providers.schedule: Occasional multi-badge days at the Disneyland Resort (e.g. Game Design + Community with the physics of the parks).
providers.notes: Independent program listed on Eventbrite. Dated sessions show on the Events tab once the Eventbrite connection is turned on.

providers.name: Legal Eagles Law Merit Badge Day (Loyola Law School)
providers.address: Loyola Law School, 919 Albany St, Los Angeles, CA 90015
providers.schedule: Annual, usually in November. Registration through Greater Los Angeles Area Council.
providers.notes: Taught by attorneys and judges. Also appears in the event search when registration is open.

providers.name: Richard Nixon Presidential Library
providers.address: 18001 Yorba Linda Blvd, Yorba Linda, CA 92886
providers.schedule: Merit badge events on an ongoing basis, usually registered through Orange County Council.

providers.name: Aquarium of the Pacific
providers.notes: The Aquarium provides a certificate of requirements completed; a counselor signs off the badge.

providers.name: WLACC Merit Badge Midway
providers.schedule: Council merit badge day with many badges.
providers.notes: Your council's own merit badge event - this entry watches the page for new dates.

providers.name: EPIC Badges Academy
providers.notes: Video lessons and workbook with a counselor who reviews the Scout's work. Check that your unit and council accept online counselors before enrolling.

providers.name: Greater Finger Lakes Council - Adventures in Virtual Merit Badges
providers.schedule: Live online classes in sessions through the year.
providers.notes: Open to Scouts from any council.

providers.name: Pathway to Adventure Council - Online/Virtual Merit Badge Classes
Atlanta Area Council - Online Merit Badge University
Malibu Lodge (Order of the Arrow, Western LA County Council)
providers.address: Western Los Angeles County Council (events at council camps, e.g. Camp Whitsett)
providers.schedule: Yearly lodge calendar: LLD/Banquet (Jan), induction weekends (Feb, May, Aug, Nov), Vigil weekend (Mar), Brotherhood Blitz (Jun), picnic (Jun), Summit (Oct).
providers.notes: Your council's OA lodge. The lodge posts a plain-text yearly calendar; this entry watches it for the 2027 dates.
